pages.lesson:
LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 1.1.1 LISTENING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do we listen to get information from an aural text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify gender roles from aural texts for information
2. respond to questions on gender roles in the community from texts for comprehension
3. recognise the importance of listening purposefully for comprehension

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information

Teach
• Focus skill: identify gender roles from aural texts for information.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we listen to get information from an aural text?
2. Why should some opportunities be equal among both girls and boys?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
